crossRefs.note: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
“The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

translations.web: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Gad, and their registration numbered 40,500.
translations.kjv: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
translations.asv: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
